purpose: Teach: バリ島/ディスコ/四重奏/チューリップ/ショコラ/ミカン/バルコニー/苺

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとバリ島へ旅行したぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when I was young, I went to Bali with your father.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Warm opening. Slow, measured pace. Voice trails slightly as if seeing the image clearly. Gentle finality on the last word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃ディスコに通われたんですって?あなた?
lines.en: Is that so, dear? I heard that when you were young, you used to go dancing at the disco.
lines.style: Warm, teasing affection beneath the surface. Gentle correction-curve in her voice. Playful accusation, not unkind. Soft question-lift at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと四重奏の演奏会を観たぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I saw a quartet perform with your father.
lines.style: Quiet nostalgia. Opening word lands softly. Breath between clauses. Slower than speech. Eyes-closed remembering. Trails off on 'quartet' like the music lingers.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭にチューリップをいっぱい植えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's right, dear — you planted so many tulips in the garden, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm counterpoint. Not challenging, but gently offering her own memory back. Soft affection on 'dear.' Slight smile in the voice. Tenderness without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがショコラをお土産にされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father brought back chocolate as a souvenir.
lines.style: Opening word softly weighted. Mid-sentence breath. Almost musing aloud. Warm appreciation. Gentle fadeout, as if tasting the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、冬になるとミカンを箱で買って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you'd buy boxes of mandarins for us every winter, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle reminder. Warm, present tense in her voice despite the past tense words. Soft possession on 'us.' Tenderness without performance. Light, easy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがホテルのバルコニーで朝食をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father had breakfast on the hotel balcony.
lines.style: Eyes opening slightly, as if bringing the scene into focus. Warm, unhurried pace. Breath before 'balcony.' Voice softens on the sensory detail. Quiet completion.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に苺ジャムを作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you made strawberry jam for our grandchildren, remember, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, tender, almost whisper-close. Warm specificity on 'strawberry jam.' Her voice wraps around the memory like holding something precious. Soft, fading finish.
